name: Zero-Trust Identity, Authentication, Model Integrity & Security Extensions
purpose: Cryptographic Creator authority, biometric security factors, QR device pairing, durable lockdown, HMAC model weight integrity, dependency verification, source tamper detection, token scanning, and release manifest management.
registration: IdentityManager::register_operator in operators_registry.json; CreatorAuthService setup; DependencyVerifier::verify_all on startup.
discovery: Token bearer extraction, device fingerprint matching, biometric challenge; TokenScanner::scan_all on incoming payloads.
memory_link: Authenticated operator identity associated with all generated memories.
learning_link: Jailbreak attempts quarantined and analyzed for adversarial defense.
self_evolution_link: Only authenticated Creator authority can trigger source code evolution or model promotion; SourceProtector guards protected symbols from unauthorized modification.
curriculum_link: Cybersecurity CVE and safety ethics datasets enforce defensive behavior.
safety_gates: Constant-time token and HMAC comparison prevents timing side-channels
Durable lockdown locks system on repeated authentication failures
ModelIntegrityEngine refuses to start if model or manifest is tampered
JailbreakDetector strips homoglyphs, invisible zero-width chars, and injection delimiters
SourceTamperDetector rejects any modification to protected source symbols
DependencyVerifier blocks startup if critical runtime dependency is missing or tampered
TokenScanner rejects prompts containing embedded credential or injection tokens

model_integrity_chain.description: Every model load and every model promotion event passes through this chain — no exceptions
chain: ModelIntegrityEngine::verify — compute dynamic SHA-256 over model.safetensors bytes
HMAC seal validated against storage/vault/access/ manifest
CANONICAL_MODEL_SHA256_UNREGISTERED sentinel checked — fail if no real model promoted
Model loaded into inference engine ONLY on full chain pass

governance_authority_chain.description: Priority order for conflicting authority claims — strictly enforced
chain: Safety (non-negotiable hard limits — physical destruction guard, anti-self-harm)
System constraints (resource limits, kinematic bounds, quota enforcement)

lifecycle.1_challenge: Incoming connection challenged for Creator or User authentication token
lifecycle.2_verify_token: Constant-time cryptographic check against registered public keys
lifecycle.3_multi_factor: Optional biometric or secondary device factor challenge
lifecycle.4_jailbreak_scan: JailbreakDetector scans payload for adversarial injection patterns
lifecycle.5_token_scan: TokenScanner scans for embedded credentials and injection tokens
lifecycle.6_model_integrity: ModelIntegrityEngine verifies HMAC seal over SafeTensors weights and manifest
lifecycle.7_dependency_verify: DependencyVerifier confirms all required runtime dependencies are present and unmodified
lifecycle.8_grant: Issue time-bounded session context with explicit capability permissions
lifecycle.9_lockdown: Trigger durable lockdown if brute-force or malicious tampering detected
